common.offline: You're offline. We'll catch up when you're back.

nav.settingsDescription: Manage your profile and account settings

appearance.description: Choose a theme, text size and language that are comfortable for you

system.label: Match my device
system.description: Light or dark, as your device is set

dark.label: Dark
dark.description: Easier on the eyes at night

contrast.label: Calm high contrast
contrast.description: Strongest contrast, for low vision or sunlight

device.label: My phone's language
device.description: English or Spanish, as your phone is set

appearance.savedNote: Your choices are saved to your account, so they follow you to every device. Your phone or computer's own text setting still applies on top.

mobile.tagline: Learn, get licensed, stay compliant and grow, all in one app.
mobile.unreachable: Can't reach the REOS server right now.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect the services REOS uses. Each one runs on demo data until you add keys and switch it on.

noResults.title: No integrations match
noResults.description: Try another word, or clear the search.

mode.label: How it runs
mode.offHint: Switched off. Features that need it are hidden.
mode.simulatorHint: Realistic demo data. No keys needed.
mode.sandboxHint: The vendor's test system, with your test keys.
mode.liveHint: Real data, with your live keys.
mode.noTestSystem: This service has no test system.
mode.liveTestFailed: The last test of the live keys failed. Fix them and test again.

keys.sandboxDescription: From the vendor's sandbox or developer account.
keys.liveDescription: From the vendor's production account. Used only when the service runs live.
keys.keepHint: Leave blank to keep the saved value.
keys.removeBody: REOS stops using them straight away. If the service was using them, it goes back to demo data. To reconnect, paste the keys again.
keys.noneNeeded: No keys needed. This service uses public data.
keys.encrypted: Keys are encrypted. After saving, only the last four characters are shown.

redirect.label: Redirect address
redirect.hint: Add this address to the app in the vendor's developer console.

accounts.user: After you save these keys, each person connects their own account from their settings.
accounts.tenant: After you save these keys, each brokerage or school connects its own account from their settings.

activity.title: Recent changes
activity.modeChanged: {{actor}} changed how it runs from {{from}} to {{to}}
activity.emptyDescription: Changes to keys and how this service runs appear here, with who made them.
activity.resumed: {{actor}} switched it back on with a passing test
activity.paused: REOS paused it after {{count}} failed health checks

checks.passed: Connected. The vendor accepted these keys.
checks.rejected: The vendor rejected these keys. Check they were copied in full and belong to this account.
checks.wrongEnvironment: These look like keys for the other system. Test keys go in Test keys, live keys in Live keys.
checks.unreachable: Couldn't reach the vendor. Try again in a few minutes.
checks.vendorError: The vendor answered with an error (code {{status}}). Try again later.
checks.invalidFormat: The {{field}} doesn't look right. Copy it again from the vendor.
checks.unexpected: Something went wrong while testing. The team has been told.
checks.noAutomaticCheck: Keys look complete. An automatic check comes with this connection's build (sprint {{sprint}}).
checks.formatOnly: The addresses look right. They are confirmed when the first error report arrives.
checks.publicData: Uses public data, so there are no keys to check.

paused.title: Paused after repeated failures
paused.body: Health checks kept failing, so REOS stopped using this service at {{time}}. Features that need it are hidden. Test the keys it runs on to switch it back on.

paused.subject: {{name}} was paused
paused.body: REOS paused {{name}} after {{count}} failed health checks in a row. Features that use it are hidden until it works again.
paused.resume: Fix the keys if needed, then press Test connection. A passing test switches it back on.
